# Cuota

> Cuota is a tiny, free and open-source Windows widget that shows how much of your Claude plan you've used: your session, weekly and per-model limits, and the time left until each one resets. Clawd keeps you company while Claude works. It's unofficial and not made by Anthropic.

- Website: https://cuota.arshitvaghasiya.com/
- Download: [CuotaSetup.exe](https://github.com/arshit09/Cuota/releases/latest/download/CuotaSetup.exe) for Windows 10 and 11, no admin rights needed
- Code: [github.com/arshit09/Cuota](https://github.com/arshit09/Cuota), GPL-3.0
- Made by: [Arshit Vaghasiya](https://arshitvaghasiya.com/)

## What it shows

- Session: your 5-hour window
- Weekly: your usage this week
- Per model: caps for models like Fable
- Bars turn amber at 75% and red at 90%. Double-click the panel for reset times, your pace, and where your week went.

## Ways to show it

- Always on top, floating above your windows
- On the desktop, behind your windows like a widget
- As tiny icons in the taskbar, by the clock
- As a desktop pet: Clawd walks your screen, naps when nothing's happening, and lets you know when Claude needs you

## Requirements and privacy

- Claude Code, logged in with a Pro or Max plan. Cuota reuses that login, so there's nothing new to sign in to.
- Your token is sent only to Anthropic. Everything else stays on your PC.
